response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software craftsman with excellent full-stack, Dlang, and Node.js skills, but he is fundamentally mismatched for this position. The role strictly requires 5 to 10 years of hands-on C++ development on Windows and deep Capital Markets or Fixed Income domain expertise. Bogdan has only about 7 months of professional C/C++ experience from 2014-2015 and lacks the specialized enterprise financial domain knowledge required.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) with a strong focus on agile methodologies, TDD, and software craftsmanship.
Solid background in establishing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps infrastructure, and test-driven development.
Some exposure to the investment and wealth-tech sector through his tenure at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Severe lack of required C++ experience; the resume shows only 7 months of professional C/C++ development nearly a decade ago.
Missing mandatory domain expertise in Fixed Income, Derivatives, Investment Banking, or Capital Markets.
Lacks demonstrated experience with enterprise SQL Server or Oracle databases, heavily favoring web-centric databases like MongoDB and MySQL.
